name: Jason
context: Full YOLO conviction portfolio. Active on r/wallstreetbets and FinTwit. Nearly half the portfolio is a single NVIDIA position — 'AI is a once-in-a-generation bet.' Thinks his Nasdaq ETF (XQQ) counts as diversification, unaware it adds even more NVDA and TSLA overlap. Tesla is a loyalty play. Bitcoin ETF because 'crypto winter is over.' Zero bonds, zero Canadian equity, zero hedges. Every macro signal hits the entire portfolio.
